positions.as_written: Use fluid sensitive sequences to show the effusion and its distribution.
Add contrast when the question is how much of what you see is thickened lining.
Use a gradient echo sequence where a blood product is suspected.
Record the distribution, since uniform and nodular behave differently.
Record the bone and the cartilage, because erosion separates the inflammatory causes.
- The report should state that infection is not excluded.
